sections.body:
```
┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│          QUERY TRANSFORMATION — QUICK REFERENCE                  │
├──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────────┤
│  Technique           │  Best For             │  Impact           │
├──────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────┤
│  1. Expansion        │  Short/vague queries  │  +recall          │
│  2. Rewriting        │  Casual/pronoun-heavy │  +precision       │
│  3. HyDE             │  Abstract questions   │  +embedding match │
│  4. Step-Back        │  Too-specific queries │  +foundational    │
│  5. Decomposition    │  Multi-part questions │  +completeness    │
│  6. Routing          │  Multi-source systems │  +efficiency      │
│  7. Multi-Query      │  Broad topic coverage │  +coverage        │
│  8. Compression      │  Long retrieved docs  │  -noise, -cost    │
└──────────────────────┴───────────────────────┴───────────────────┘

┌──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│               CHUNKING — QUICK REFERENCE                         │
├──────────────────────┬───────────────────────┬───────────────────┤
│  Strategy            │  Best For             │  Key Tradeoff     │
├──────────────────────┼───────────────────────┼───────────────────┤
│  1. Fixed-Size       │  Quick start/uniform  │  Fast, imprecise  │
│  2. Recursive        │  General text (80%)   │  Best default     │
│  3. Semantic         │  Topic-varied docs    │  Slow index, best │
│  4. Sentence Window  │  Dense technical      │  Precise + context│
│  5. Hierarchical     │  Books/long docs      │  Multi-granular   │
│  6. Code-Aware       │  Source code          │  AST-precise      │
│  7. Proposition      │  Factual QA           │  Atomic, costly   │
│  8. Late Chunking    │  Pronoun-rich docs    │  Context-perfect  │
└──────────────────────┴───────────────────────┴───────────────────┘

  THE DECISION TREE:
  ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  CHUNKING:
  "Is it source code?"              → Code-Aware
  "Is it a long structured doc?"    → Hierarchical
  "Do I need atomic facts for QA?"  → Proposition
  "Do I want max retrieval quality?"→ Semantic
  "Do I want context around hits?"  → Sentence Window
  "Do I just need something fast?"  → Recursive (default)

  QUERY TRANSFORMATION:
  "Is query < 5 words?"             → Expand it
  "Does it have pronouns / casual?" → Rewrite it
  "Is it a debugging/why question?" → Step-Back
  "Is it multi-part?"               → Decompose
  "Need comprehensive coverage?"    → Multi-Query
  "Multiple data sources?"          → Route it first
  "Retrieved docs are very long?"   → Compress them
```
